description: Customer quotes with attribution — for social proof sections. 'grid' layout lays out quote cards 1-col mobile / 2-3 col desktop; 'stack' layout is a single centered column for one or two large quotes.

id.description: Optional HTML id attribute for anchor linking (e.g. navigation anchors).

title.description: Section heading above the testimonials. Omit if the context makes it clear. Plain text — HTML is escaped.

title_accent.description: Optional exact substring of title to render in an accent color. Must match title exactly (case-sensitive) or it is ignored.

eyebrow.description: Optional short kicker/label rendered as a pill above the title. Plain text — HTML is escaped.

subheading.description: Optional supporting line below the title. Plain text — HTML is escaped.

title_align.description: Alignment of the eyebrow/title/subheading header block. 'start' = left-aligned (default, unchanged historical behavior). 'center' = centered.

layout.description: Structural layout. 'grid' = card grid, 1-col mobile / 2-3 col desktop. 'stack' = single centered column, for one or two large pull-quotes.

theme.description: Background color/tone for this band. 'default' = the band's own default background (no tone override). 'muted' = light tinted surface band (renders the --color-surface background with framing top and bottom borders). 'inverted' = inverted dark background for strong contrast; use 'inverted' for a genuinely dark band.

items.description: Array of testimonial items. Each: { quote (req), author, role, company, image_url, image_alt, image_id }.

quote.description: The testimonial text. Inline HTML allowed: a, strong, em, br.

author.description: Name of the person quoted. Plain text — HTML is escaped.

image_alt.description: Alt text for the avatar. Use the author's name; empty string only if image is purely decorative.

image_id.description: Media Library attachment ID (NOT a URL). When it resolves to a real attachment, the image renders responsively with srcset/sizes via wp_get_attachment_image() instead of a single fixed-size . Falls back to image_url when unset or unresolvable. Get an attachment id via the import_media apply.

--testimonials-padding-top.description: Top padding of the band. Defaults to the shared symmetric band rhythm (fluid ~68-80px desktop, ~54px mobile); set an explicit length to override.

--testimonials-padding-bottom.description: Bottom padding of the band. Defaults to the shared symmetric band rhythm; set an explicit length to override.

--testimonials-heading-size.description: Heading font size. Defaults to the shared responsive band-heading scale (fluid ~28px mobile to ~42px desktop); set an explicit length to override.

--testimonials-heading-measure.description: Maximum width of the testimonials heading. Routes the shared --measure-heading design token (40rem) by default, so retuning that ONE token changes every routed band heading at once; set a length here only when THIS band must differ from the rest of the site.

--testimonials-heading-accent-color.description: Color of the title_accent substring within the heading, if set

--testimonials-eyebrow-radius.description: Eyebrow pill corner radius. Set a large value (e.g. 999px) for a fully rounded pill.

--testimonials-eyebrow-border-width.description: Eyebrow pill border width. Set a non-zero width (with --testimonials-eyebrow-border-color) for an outlined pill; 0 (default) renders no border.

--testimonials-eyebrow-border-color.description: Eyebrow pill border color. Takes effect when --testimonials-eyebrow-border-width is non-zero.

--testimonials-eyebrow-text-transform.description: Eyebrow pill letter-casing. Default uppercase renders the kicker in caps; set none to keep it as authored (e.g. sentence case), or lowercase / capitalize.

--testimonials-subheading-margin-bottom.description: Space between the subheading and the content below it

--testimonials-heading-margin-bottom.description: Space between the heading and the subheading below it

--testimonials-gap.description: Gap between testimonial cards (grid layout) or between stacked quotes (stack layout)

--testimonials-item-shadow.description: Card box shadow / glow (preset var(--shadow-sm|md|lg) or a bounded box-shadow)

dark-showcase.description: Dark background with light cards for a strong social-proof section
